dataset.name: Dataset501_OLES3D9Organs
dataset.test_access_policy: No policy selection or tuning; final locked evaluation only

common_training.network_loss_augmentation_optimizer_sche: identical nnU-Net v2.8.1 plan and trainer lineage
common_training.loader_reproducibility: default nondeterministic workers; no bitwise reproducibility claim
common_training.stage_b_checkpoint_schedule_status: Implemented in the common trainer; static contract passed; runtime milestone smoke pending

guided_common.schedule: same seeded train-only case permutation and focus-organ rotation

B1.policy: online error pools; fixed-uniform organ allocation; pooled voxel-uniform error types

A1.policy: B1 plus focus-organ hard-Dice-deficit EMA allocation

P.policy: A1 plus organ-local raw-error-share EMA type allocation

evaluation.metric: case-first macro Dice over all 9 selected organs
evaluation.aggregation: mean over 9 organs within each case, then mean over cases
evaluation.ground_truth_empty: protocol violation because frozen eligible cohort requires all nine organs nonempty

stage_a_original_primary_hypothesis.question: Does P improve final 30k case-first macro Dice over B0?
stage_a_original_primary_hypothesis.status: Retired as an OLES3D claim by explicit user decision after Stage-A seed 55254
stage_a_original_primary_hypothesis.evidence: P-B0 at 30k was -0.0139 percentage points with a case-bootstrap interval containing zero
stage_a_original_primary_hypothesis.claim_boundary: One seed does not prove universal absence of an effect; the project no longer spends replication budget claiming final-Dice superiority

stage_b_confirmatory_primary.question: Does P improve 10k case-first macro Dice over B0 on independent replication seeds?
stage_b_confirmatory_primary.contrast: P minus B0 at 10000 optimizer updates
stage_b_confirmatory_primary.inference_unit: paired training seed and validation case
stage_b_confirmatory_primary.planned_interval: two-way paired bootstrap over seeds and cases
stage_b_confirmatory_primary.success_rule: 95% two-way bootstrap interval lower bound above zero and positive seed-level mean delta in all three replication seeds
stage_b_confirmatory_primary.selection_disclosure: Chosen after the seed-55254 Stage-A 10k discovery result; confirmation uses only new seeds

stage_b_efficiency_secondary.status: Selected after Stage-A discovery and before Stage-B execution
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.normalized_auc: Trapezoidal area under the case-first macro Dice curve from 5k through 30k, divided by the 25k-update interval
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.target_crossing: Piecewise-linear interpolation between the first adjacent checkpoints that bracket the target; no extrapolation and report not reached
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.time_to_target: Use actual cumulative logged epoch time at milestone checkpoints and the same local interpolation; include observer overhead
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.analysis_unit: Compute each curve within training seed using the same 28 paired validation cases, then summarize seeds and use paired seed-by-case resampling
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.claim_boundary: Update efficiency and wall-clock efficiency are separate; a reduction in updates does not establish a reduction in elapsed time
stage_b_efficiency_secondary.selection_disclosure: Targets were selected after inspecting seed 55254 and are evaluated as prespecified secondary endpoints only on seeds 55255, 55256, and 55257

stage_b_key_secondary: B0/B1/A1/P case-first macro Dice at 5k, 10k, 15k, 20k, 25k, and 30k on replication seeds
Normalized area under the 5k-30k validation learning curve on replication seeds
Updates-to-target at Dice 0.80, 0.85, and 0.90 with no extrapolation
Wall-clock time-to-target from actual cumulative checkpoint time including observer overhead
Four-smallest-organ macro defined only by validation GT voxel count
Per-organ Dice and case-level paired differences
Training wall-clock, adaptive-observer overhead, inference time, and peak VRAM
Raw-output NSD 3 mm, HD95 mm, empty predictions, and detached-component failure audit at 30k
evaluation.final_30k_role: Safety and convergence guardrail, not a superiority endpoint; report P-B0 interval without an unjustified noninferiority margin

final_test_contract.status: Selected before Stage-B execution; held-out test remains unopened
final_test_contract.launch_gate: Run only if the frozen Stage-B confirmatory primary success rule passes; otherwise preserve the test and do not use it to rescue the claim
final_test_contract.primary_role: External confirmation of the frozen 10k P-B0 efficiency contrast
final_test_contract.safety_role: Report 30k final Dice and surface guardrails without retuning
final_test_contract.forbidden: No method, target, cohort, checkpoint, or analysis selection after viewing test results

secondary_surface_metric_contract.status: Selected before Stage-A surface metric computation; user execution complete
secondary_surface_metric_contract.nsd_tolerance_role: Technical two-voxel tolerance at 1.5 mm spacing; not a clinical tolerance claim
secondary_surface_metric_contract.prediction_empty: NSD=0; HD95 undefined; report surface failure count
secondary_surface_metric_contract.aggregation: Unweighted organ macro within case, then mean over cases
secondary_surface_metric_contract.test_policy: Freeze implementation and validation behavior before the single held-out test evaluation

execution_order.stage_b: Run three independent replication seeds 55255-55257 for all four methods; 16 total runs across 4 seeds including development seed 55254
execution_order.cloud_policy: Deploy RunPod only for bounded smoke/main training/inference; stop between GPU-dependent gates

seed_plan_revision.reason: Explicit user expansion before Stage-B execution: retain the complete four-policy ablation and six-point learning curves while strengthening training-seed replication
seed_plan_revision.scope: Seed 55254 remains discovery-only for the new 10k hypothesis; all four methods add seeds 55255, 55256, and 55257 for replication
seed_plan_revision.status: Selected before Stage B execution; campaign and checkpoint schedule implemented; runtime smoke pending
seed_plan_revision.limitation: The efficiency endpoint was generated from Stage-A validation; three new seeds improve but do not eliminate training-seed uncertainty

research_direction_revision.authority: Explicit user instruction after Stage-A 30k and 10k evidence
research_direction_revision.retired_claim: P improves final 30k Dice over the nnU-Net B0 baseline
research_direction_revision.new_claim_under_test: Organ-wise error-type-adaptive patch sampling improves early learning efficiency at matched update budget, especially for small or difficult organs, while final performance and surface failure modes are reported as guardrails
research_direction_revision.development_evidence: At seed 55254, P-B0 macro Dice was +5.1228 percentage points at 10k (26 of 28 case wins) and +0.9603 points at 20k (21 of 28 case wins), while the 30k difference was -0.0139 points; these discovery-seed results suggest a transient early-learning advantage and are not confirmatory evidence
research_direction_revision.anti_hindsight_rule: Do not count seed 55254 as confirmatory for the newly selected 10k endpoint; freeze Stage-B checkpoint, metric, comparison, and analysis code before seeds 55255-55257
research_direction_revision.scope_guard: No backbone, loss, augmentation, cohort, label, or held-out-test changes; novelty remains patch-sampling policy and learning efficiency

change_control: Any scientific change after this freeze requires a recorded reason, affected methods, rerun scope, and no held-out-test-driven selection
